Use case: stylized-concept. Near-photographic cinematic painterly realism for the Korean post-collapse road-trip game Seoul to 400km. Grounded Korean people and infrastructure, restrained cool gray-blue palette, wet or dusty weathered materials, one practical warm amber light source where inhabited, natural anatomy, human-scale action, subtle film grain, believable 35-50mm film-still composition. Match the attached Caravan canonical references exactly in medium, palette, character identity and vehicle design.
Asset type: ONE landscape cinematic title-scene concept, 1536x864 or larger exact 16:9. All attached images are canonical STYLE/IDENTITY REFERENCES, not edit targets; do not copy the sheets, labels or panels.
Scene: early morning at Busan Gamcheon wharf before departure, a quiet weathered Korean harbor, pale diffuse morning sky, distant harbor cranes and stacked containers. The SAME cream Korean cab-over one-ton truck Dalguji from technical reference parked on the quay, camera at human eye height 35-50mm from rear-left three-quarter, truck cab pointing right. Entire compact truck is visible centrally, occupies roughly 60% image width, roof and all wheels in frame. Preserve distinct straight rectangular living box behind cab, three small amber windows, roof tarp bundles tied with rope, exactly two red fuel cans on roof, rear ladder, antenna, worn white X on cab. Ordinary damp ground, restrained amber window glow. No people, no dog, no companions, no other hero vehicle. No famous landmark. Room above truck for natural harbor atmosphere, but NO drawn typography/UI. Composition should read clearly at mobile 360px wide. Vehicle is not upgraded or extravagant. ONE unified film-still image, not a collage.
